limits: Sweep source address attribution is reported exchange association, not an independent legal theft determination for every unit.
Unexplained residuals are not forced to zero; rebasing/fee-on-transfer/nonstandard token events and missing flows need separate interpretation.
No ticker-only USD assignment. Raw per-token balances cannot be added across currencies.
Receipts/traces/headers are source evidence, not cryptographic state proofs.
